name: chad_baseball
tag: how do i change this part?? anyway GO EAGLES
about: hey!! my sister set this page up for me and i typed this part MYSELF which is why some of it is in CAPS, the button sticks and honestly?? i've grown to like it. i play left field for the eagles. i clicked something last week and everything went bold for 3 days, todd fixed it, todd is a GENIUS. things i support: baseball, my friends, my friends' weird hobbies i don't understand, and this WEBSITE. if u ever need someone to cheer for u i am AVAILABLE and i am LOUD.

interests.General: baseball, batting cages (tokens in my glove), high fives (holding back), cheering for my friends' stuff (all of it) (don't get it) (SUPPORT it), coach's truck, sunflower seeds, being head of security for a garage band (moved a chair once)
interests.Music: eye of the tiger, whatever's in coach's truck (country) (some of it's good), static prophecy (i was the WHOLE crowd), the song they play at the stadium when someone hits a homer (i don't know the name) (i know all the words) (there are no words)
interests.Movies: rookie of the year, the sandlot (CLASSIC), field of dreams (my dad cried) (i cried) (we don't talk about it), remember the titans (i cheered at the tv), those are the movies
interests.Television: baseball tonight, sportscenter (the top 10) (i cheer at those too), american gladiators (the old ones) (dad's tapes), whatever kevin's arcade tv is playing (seen it 40 times) (still good)
interests.Books: the eagles playbook (it's 4 pages), the back of baseball cards (i read them ALL), the book my sister gave me about 'how to use a computer' (page 3) (it's a lot of buttons)
interests.Heroes: ken griffey jr. coach (pain is weakness leaving the body) (it's just pain) (still). my sister (set up the page). todd (fixed the bold thing). patrick (best high five). EVERYONE ON THIS WEBSITE honestly
